# Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 regular-board source assets

- Official STEP archive: `official-step.zip` (SHA-256 `0d552ed2cc7359ea132601f4f7fe2c9d816e2dfe4f58f6463e83f84a901d3650`)
- Extracted STEP: `source/XIAO-ESP32S3 v2.step` (SHA-256 `870ad45c7af5d92324cec4c6ae65fbf86e3b049d5a97ab9ffd9039ebd73455dd`)
- Converted web model: `public/models/seeed-xiao-esp32-s3.glb` (SHA-256 `866adb2f4068574976bd1b5f7763a07e1d800bbc2e489a3efdfe473dbf5424d2`)
- Matching Seeed Studio model listing: https://www.printables.com/model/1344060-3d-model-for-seeed-studio-xiao-esp32-s3 (CC BY-SA 4.0)
- Official documentation and model resource page: https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/xiao_esp32s3_getting_started/
- Image license policy for Seeed documentation and associated images: https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/License/

The archive also contains `Top view.jpg` and `Bottom View.jpg`. The source renders are copied unchanged to `public/board-reference/seeed-xiao-esp32-s3-top.jpg` and `...-bottom.jpg`, with Seeed attribution and CC BY-SA 4.0 shown in the catalog.

The PCB geometry is 20.955 × 17.78 mm in the imported STEP. The STEP is Y-up for this viewer and is centered without reflection. Only source mesh names `SOLID`, `Shield`, and `U.FL-R-SMT-1_10_ v1` receive explicit names in the UI. Other mesh/feature shapes remain unidentified.

The file named `official-cad.zip` that was downloaded alongside this archive is **not** the regular board. Its archive root identifies XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense v1.5. It has been separated into the sibling `seeed-xiao-esp32s3-sense` source folder. Do not combine it with this model. No Sense model is published until its exact geometry and file-specific terms are audited.
